common_name: Yellow Submarine Rose (Bright Yellow Easy Elegance Landscape Rose)

planting.note: Plant own-root or container roses in spring in well-drained, fertile soil in full sun; Yellow Submarine is part of the Easy Elegance landscape rose series bred by Ping Lim for disease resistance and low maintenance, grown on its own roots.

directions: Plant in well-drained, fertile soil in full sun; Yellow Submarine bears clusters of bright, clear golden-yellow blooms on a compact, own-root landscape rose bred by Ping Lim as part of the Easy Elegance series, developed specifically for strong disease resistance and low-maintenance garden performance without the heavy spray programs older roses require. It blooms continuously from late spring through frost, and because it grows on its own roots rather than being grafted, any winter dieback simply regrows true to type. Deadhead spent clusters to encourage continued bloom, and prune back by about a third in late winter to keep the plant compact and vigorous.
sources: Bailey Nurseries — Easy Elegance Rose Collection
